seo.title: mtadmin Admin Dashboard Template for Next.js and React
seo.description: Build production-ready admin dashboards with mtadmin for Next.js and React. Get 14 dashboards, 90 application routes, six layouts, reusable TypeScript components, and an all-framework bundle.

faqs.question: What does an individual mtadmin edition include?
faqs.answer: An individual purchase unlocks the complete source package for the selected framework, including all included dashboards, routes, layouts, and reusable components.

faqs.question: What is included in the all-frameworks bundle?
faqs.answer: The bundle includes the Next.js and React editions immediately. HTML, Vue.js, Angular, and Laravel editions are added to the same account when they are released.

faqs.question: Is mtadmin a subscription?
faqs.answer: No. Individual editions and the bundle are one-time purchases with lifetime access to the purchased product.

faqs.question: Can I use mtadmin in a commercial client project?
faqs.answer: Yes. The license permits personal and commercial end products, but it does not permit reselling or redistributing the template source.

faqs.question: What happens after payment?
faqs.answer: After Paddle confirms the transaction, the purchased edition or bundle is attached to your mtverse account. You can download it immediately from the confirmation page and return to your account for later downloads.

faqs.question: How are payments processed?
faqs.answer: Payments are processed securely by Paddle as the merchant of record. mtverse does not store card details, and checkout supports major cards and eligible wallet or local payment methods shown by Paddle.

faqs.question: Do you offer refunds?
faqs.answer: Refund requests are handled under the mtverse refund policy. Contact support with the purchase email and Paddle transaction ID so the order can be reviewed.

faqs.question: Will I receive product updates?
faqs.answer: Individual purchases include updates for that framework edition. The all-frameworks bundle also includes future mtadmin framework editions when they are released.
